title: How to get the quarter-end date for any date
task: Snap a date to its quarter's last day — reporting cutoffs, fiscal deadlines.

excel.note: CEILING(month/3)*3 finds the quarter's last month; EOMONTH finds its last day.

explanation: Month 7 divided by 3 and ceiled gives quarter 3; times 3 gives its closing month (September); EOMONTH lands on the 30th. The quarter-START date is the same construction minus two months: DATE(YEAR(A2),CEILING(MONTH(A2)/3,1)*3-2,1). For fiscal years that don't start in January, shift the month first with MOD before the arithmetic — or add a helper column, which everyone can read.
